request: Independent adversarial interactive review of character physics across arenas, with fixes for reproduced defects.

method.browser: T3 collaborative preview, private agent-owned tabs
method.interactiveMutation: Normal UI clicks and keyboard controls only. Fighter coordinates, HP, stocks and simulation ticks are never assigned by the browser harness.
method.observation: Stable traversal checks read Game's React UI snapshot, updated about every 100 ms. The one-tick edge regression retains Game's first unmodified structuredClone and observes the existing projectile-array assignment after body separation on every live physical step; original function/descriptor are restored in finally.

controls.P1: A/D, W, S, J/K/L, ShiftLeft, U

method.selection: Every match selects both named fighters through the visible roster search and arena through its selector, then verifies the actual fighter IDs and stage in the created match.
method.guard: Elevated traversal specials guard the unattended opponent with U/0 and wait for long-lived projectiles. Deliberate contact sessions leave the target unguarded; floor-only specials may make ordinary combat contact.
method.rosterBasis: Shared gravity 0.52 and jump velocities −12.8/−11; roster has no separate mass parameter. Selected actual speed extremes 3.5–6.3, incoming-damage multipliers 0.86–1.07, dash/brake, reverse dash, vertical lift, staged steps, blink, ground snare, gravity/bounce and returning/pulling projectiles.
method.reportPrecision: Coordinates are rounded to three decimals for readability; assertions used original values. SHA-256 hashes were calculated over the full unrounded JSON received by each client, not these summarized snapshots. Ride arrays are [tick,x,y]. Representative special frames use representativeKeyFrameColumns.

confirmedFinding.symptom: Body separation could move a grounded fighter past the support's five-unit tolerance while leaving grounded=true/supportPlatform unchanged until another collision step; opposing inputs could sustain this beyond a single tick.
confirmedFinding.cause: Support was computed before body-separation adjustments and was not revalidated afterwards.
confirmedFinding.fix: Revalidate support after body separation, clearing grounded/supportPlatform immediately when the final x leaves its surface. Preserve the fighter's resulting position, velocity and ordinary next-step gravity.

regressions.coverage: Both slots, both edges, all nine main floors and 20 elevated surfaces; four phases for each of five moving mechanisms.

browserGreen.server: production localhost:5393; local simulation uses new bundle
browserGreen.captureMode: each physical step, after body separation
browserGreen.result: At the first sampled physical step outside x=1055, the victim immediately has grounded=false/support=null; next-step gravity remains ordinary.

complementaryStress.policy: Seeded reactive input policy from natural createMatch introductions. Both variants are deterministic individually; the policy responds to changed positions, so red/green are not identical input replays.
complementaryStress.budget: 2400 stepMatch calls per match. 359 finish naturally; 10 reach the input budget.

verification.build: npm run build passed; existing Vite bundle-size warning

limits: Interactive traversal covers 12 of 41 built-in characters, 18 distinct character/stage combinations and both slots across the matrix; it is not all 369 UI combinations or every selected character in both slots.
This round's deliberate inputs use desktop keyboard controls. Gamepad/touch behaviors are not retested by this matrix.
Specific special techniques and body contact are tested; no claim of exhaustive move/pair/phase coverage.
Prior QA reports cover account and room flows; this review adds character-specific physics evidence.
The online server publishes every two simulation ticks; exact one-tick support release is established by the separate live local observer and regression matrix.
reproduce: In a T3 collaborative preview tab at localhost:5393, evaluate scripts/journey-browser-probe.js, then scripts/character-platforms-browser-audit.js. Trim file contents; await installation only, not the long-running jobs.
Run __characterPhysics.startContact(4,'heavy',[0,1]), then (4,'special',[1]), then (6,'heavy',[0,1]), then (7,'special',[1]); wait for .job between calls.
Run __characterPhysics.startEdgePush(); the corrected build must produce zero violations and capture a victim outside x=1055 with grounded=false/support=null.

online.method: Both browser profiles joined the same private room through UI. Only normal keyboard controls moved fighters. Capture stores WebSocket states and compares SHA-256 of full JSON at matching ticks; the protocol samples every two simulation ticks, rather than every physical step.

room.name: La sala de Empujón online MCM

online.harnessCorrection: The first guest parking attempt reached x990 because host x330 plus the intentional maximum retreat separation660 prevented x1020. Moving the host to x700 allowed guest parking at x1017.5; no engine state was changed.
online.limitation: This online check validates published states for the fixed case. The independent local browser observer and engine regression cover the exact physical step.

verdict: One reproducible physics defect was fixed: body separation retained support beyond a ledge. The corrected build passes all recorded interactive, engine and online checks below.

projectileObservation.method: Read-only analysis of emitted projectile samples from the actual keyboard special traces. Twenty sampled intervals match the discrete gravity equations within 0.002; the returning lasso reverses horizontal direction.
projectileObservation.limits: These samples do not cover complete bounce lifetimes or every projectile/opponent/platform interaction.

harnessCorrections.issue: The first dash check assumed rightward motion.
harnessCorrections.evidence: P2 was idle and automatically faced the rival to its left; its real dash moved left at vx=-14.
harnessCorrections.resolution: Check actual dash displacement and active dash state without assuming a fixed facing direction.

harnessCorrections.issue: Early parking commands directed both fighters through one another.
harnessCorrections.evidence: Guaira stopped at the ordinary 43-unit body separation.
harnessCorrections.resolution: Keep their relative order while parking; choose the actor's corresponding outer edge for recovery.
harnessCorrections.classification: Harness control policy; no product fix.

harnessCorrections.issue: An unattended rival was hit by Sayona's actual blink special during traversal.
harnessCorrections.resolution: Preserve this as legitimate contact/knockback evidence; guard the unattended rival and allow projectile expiry in isolated traversal cases.
harnessCorrections.classification: Harness stock-preservation assumption; expected combat behavior.

harnessCorrections.issue: The first edge check sampled the UI clone at approximately six-tick intervals and missed the transient defect.
harnessCorrections.resolution: Do not use that coarse passing run as absence-of-bug evidence. Retain the unmodified local simulation clone and observe each physical step; require outside-support samples.
harnessCorrections.classification: Observation gap. The later live RED detects the real product defect.

harnessCorrections.issue: The first attempted property observer was attached to the UI clone and recorded zero physical steps.
harnessCorrections.resolution: Fail the evidence precondition, retain the actual advancing simulation identity, and restore all observation hooks in finally.

harnessCorrections.issue: An edge repro initially parked too close and let P2 coast off before the push.
harnessCorrections.resolution: Park at x=1020 by ordinary steering and require two stocks plus valid initial support before starting the pusher.
harnessCorrections.classification: Harness setup failure; excluded from red/green counts.

harnessCorrections.issue: A root escape check could otherwise wait until the effect expired naturally.
harnessCorrections.resolution: Stop capture while rootTicks>0/stun=0, assert active roots immediately before the fresh jump, then verify airborne state and rootTicks=0.
harnessCorrections.classification: Harness assertion strengthened before the valid contact run.

visualInspection.method: Actual game canvas copied to 600x334 JPEG for inspection without the pause overlay.

Sarcos/Reynaldo together on Los Roques' raft
visualInspection.result: Observed support surfaces and fighter placements agree visually in these captures; numeric collision/render regressions cover geometry separately.
